correctness: Full 960x540 and odd 961x541 grids, isolated changes to all 65 words, negative controls, sequence checks, final timed-frame check outside every energy window
diagnostics: A/A controls, duration sweep, polling-counter perturbation, boundary-only monitor ablation, copy-only lower-work control
endpoints: Both counter query before/after times; power query before/after times; workload start/end; raw mJ
inference: Exploratory fixed-budget follow-up; no formal power calculation claimed; report seed/session structure and raw pairs
inputs: Precomputed state traces; generation and hashing outside measurement; CPU dirty decisions and uploads inside measurement
primary_analysis: Main comparisons on power-only polling with boundary counters; both estimators reported; no frame pseudoreplication
purpose: Diagnose telemetry disagreement and exact reuse at matched cadence; no calibrated energy guarantee
scope: Synthetic offscreen GPU telemetry; excludes display and CPU/system energy; no independent power instrument
software_changes: No driver, clock, power-limit or persistent power-plan changes. Temporarily prevent idle sleep.
stopping_rule: Fixed plan, not significance-based. Stop on correctness, API, AC-loss, or 85 C safety failure; retain partial/adverse data
timing: Five CUDA event boundaries in every policy/frame; intervals may include host submission gaps; all costs explicitly retained. Instrumentation and input replay differ from v1; do not pool v1 and v2 timing results.
